title: Slot claim expiry gate is fail-open until first wall-clock sync
description: coap_slot_coord.c:1452:412 - lichen_wall_clock_get() returns 0 when clock is unsynced (time_sync.c:788), so claim->expiry <= now_unix is false for every claim until first sync: spec GCP-6.5 step 7 (expiry) is bypassed from boot to first time sync. Kconfig depends-on guarantees compilation, not a valid clock. Fix: gate the expiry check on lichen_wall_clock_valid() (exists in time_sync, unused here) and reject/defer claims while the clock is unset, per spec semantics - decide reject vs pending, do not fail open. Add test: now_unix==0 with stale expiry.
